protocol.title: Ultra-sensitive Digital Quantification of Proteins and mRNA in Single Cells
protocol.platform: Automated microfluidic digital proximity ligation assay (u-dPLA); two-layer push-up PDMS device with ddPCR/RT-ddPCR readout
cell_lines: H1299 (human lung epithelial, non-small cell lung carcinoma)
A549 (human lung epithelial, adenocarcinoma; HSV-1 infection assay)
protocol.objective: Ultrasensitive simultaneous quantification of protein copy numbers and mRNA in single mammalian cells using microfluidic digital proximity ligation assay (u-dPLA) with up to 55-fold improved LOD over regular dPLA, combined with live-cell imaging and chemical stimulation capability

layers: Fluidic layer (thick, top): SU-8 70 um two-layer + AZ 18 um rounded channels; push-up design
Control layer (thin, bottom): SU-8 22 um; microfluidic valves operated by Matlab-controlled pneumatic actuators
device.chip_dimensions: 127.76 mm x 85.48 mm x 1 mm glass substrate

chamber_architecture.chamber_II: Single-cell trap (50 um constriction); cell imaged and lysed here
chamber_architecture.chamber_IV: Probe-lysate diffusion mixing extension zone; valve between III and IV opened during incubation
chamber_architecture.output_port: 1930 um inner diameter biopsy punch; PLA products retrieved here for ddPCR

valve_system.dead_end_filling: Precise nanoliter volumes delivered to empty chambers with predefined volumes

device.wash_channels: Dedicated wash channels between reagent steps to prevent cross-contamination

reagents.blocking_agent: 10% BSA in PBS (Cat. No. 37525, Thermo Fisher); 1 h incubation; washed with MilliQ water
reagents.lysis_buffer: 0.3x TM buffer + protease inhibitor (Cat. No. K3011010, BioChain) in cell resuspension buffer (Cat. No. 4405443, Thermo Fisher)

pla_probes.TNFR1: Biotinylated antibody BAF225 (R&D Systems) conjugated via streptavidin-biotin; oligo kit Cat. No. 4448549 (Applied Biosystems)
pla_probes.CD147: Biotinylated antibody BAF972 (R&D Systems) conjugated via streptavidin-biotin; oligo kit Cat. No. 4448549 (Applied Biosystems)
pla_probes.HSV1: Anti-HSV-1 polyclonal antibody ab9533 (Abcam) conjugated in-house via DBCO-NHS/azide click chemistry; detects ~80 HSV-1 viral protein species
pla_probes.probe_binding_buffer: 0.1% BSA + 0.05% Tween-20 + 100 nM goat IgG + 0.1 g/L sheared salmon sperm DNA in PBS

ddpcr_readout.supermix: ddPCR Supermix for Probes Cat. No. 1863024 (Bio-Rad)
ddpcr_readout.droplet_generation_oil: Droplet Generation Oil for Probes Cat. No. 1863005 (Bio-Rad)

rt_ddpcr_duplex.TNFR1_taqman_probe: TNFR1 TaqMan Gene Expression Assay Cat. No. Hs01042313_m1 (Applied Biosystems); 1 uL
rt_ddpcr_duplex.RNaseOUT: Cat. No. 10777019 (Invitrogen); diluted 20x in all reagent mixes

cell_culture.HEK293T: DMEM (Cat. No. 11965-092, Life Technologies) + 10% FBS (Cat. No. F9665, Sigma-Aldrich)
cell_culture.dissociation: TrypLE (Cat. No. 12605028, Life Technologies) 5 min at 37C

hsv1_infection.virus_stock_preparation: Vero cells, MOI 0.01, harvest Day 3 by three freeze-thaw cycles
hsv1_infection.reporter: ICP4-YFP (nuclear signal in successfully infected cells)
hsv1_infection.icp4_role: Major immediate-early transcription factor; expressed upon viral genome nuclear entry, prior to genome replication

steps.name: BSA surface blocking
steps.notes: Coats PDMS surfaces to minimise non-specific adsorption of PLA probes and lysate proteins. Washed with MilliQ water and ventilated with compressed air before cell loading.

steps.name: Calibration curve loading (on-chip)
steps.operation: serial dead-end filling + probe incubation + ligation
steps.notes: Calibration curve run in parallel with single-cell experiments on same chip. Converts ddPCR amplicon counts per uL to absolute protein copy numbers. LOD defined as 3 SD above background or y-intercept of fitted linear curve (whichever is higher).

steps.name: Single-cell loading and hydrodynamic trapping
steps.operation: pressure-driven flow-through trap (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Cell loading verified visually under microscope. Chip immediately moved to ice after loading. BioScript mix abstraction represents pressure-driven hydrodynamic trapping, not DMF electrode actuation.

steps.name: Single-cell lysis
steps.notes: Lysis confirmed visually under microscope. 100% of 7-nL lysate used in downstream ddPCR (vs 9% in regular dPLA). Eliminating dilution from well-plate sorting is the primary source of 55x sensitivity gain.

steps.name: PLA probe incubation with cell lysate
steps.mechanism: Oligonucleotide-tagged antibody pairs bind two distinct epitopes on target protein; proximity (<3-5 nm) enables connector-mediated ligation
steps.notes: Channels I and II flushed with probes for 2 min and 15 min respectively before introduction to Chamber III.

steps.name: Ligation reaction
steps.operation: dead-end filling pushing probe-lysate from III/IV to Chamber V
steps.notes: T4 ligase seals nick between probe oligonucleotides when both are bound to same protein molecule, generating a circular DNA PLA product quantified by ddPCR.

steps.name: PLA product retrieval and ddPCR readout

results.TNFR1_HEK293T: All below LOD; TNFR1 not expressed or below detection in HEK293T

steps.name: Duplex protein and mRNA quantification (same single cell)
steps.operation: one-step RT-ddPCR duplex with PLA products

results.comparison_to_previous_estimates: Significantly higher than previous ~0.1 estimates (Taniguchi 2010, Albayrak 2016)
results.finding: Including lowly-expressing cells (below previous dPLA LOD) increases mRNA-protein correlation; Spearman coefficient increases as more low-protein cells are included (Fig. 3e)

steps.name: HSV-1 viral infection live-cell imaging and viral protein quantification
steps.operation: on-chip live-cell time-lapse imaging + u-dPLA viral protein quantification

imaging.reporter: ICP4-YFP (nuclear YFP signal = successful infection = viral genome nuclear entry)
imaging.fluorescence_calculation: Matlab imfindcircles + ImageJ Rolling Ball Background Subtraction; sum pixel values within cell circle
imaging.uninfected_criterion: No YFP signal (virus received but infection unsuccessful)

lysis_and_pla.pla_probe: Polyclonal anti-HSV-1 (ab9533, Abcam); detects ~80 HSV-1 viral protein species

results.interpretation: Partial correlation between ICP4-YFP level and total viral protein count; not all HSV-1 infected cells progress past immediate-early protein synthesis; sub-population undergoes abortive infection
results.heterogeneity: Highest-expressing cells show ~5x more viral protein than lowest-expressing infected cells

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: BSA blocking, calibration curve, single-cell trap, lysis, PLA probe incubation, ligation, PLA product retrieval, ddPCR assembly and thermal cycling

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(proteinSignal); duplex RT-ddPCR assembly and thermal cycling; mRNA detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(mrnaSignal); HSV-1 cell trapping, live-cell imaging, lysis, viral PLA, ddPCR; viral protein detection

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s (seconds) or m (minutes); BioScript does not support h token

abstraction_notes.mix: Abstracts valve-gated dead-end filling and diffusion-based mixing inside sealed nanoliter chambers; no DMF electrode actuation involved; fluid movement is pneumatically driven via Matlab-controlled valve sequencing
abstraction_notes.heat: Abstracts on-chip or bench incubation steps (ice, 37C, 65C); for ddPCR thermal cycling, heat statements model the QX200 thermal cycler program off-chip after product retrieval
abstraction_notes.detect: Abstracts ddPCR or RT-ddPCR positive-droplet counting readout; actual droplet generation and plate reading occur off-chip
abstraction_notes.cell_occupancy: Single cell modelled as one SingleCell manifest unit per assay unit; ~90% average occupancy
abstraction_notes.pcr_cycles: 40 cycles of 94C/95C 30s + 60C 1min = 90s each; 40 x 90s = 3600s = 60m modelled as single heat statement
